BMCRI vs Vydehi Institute of Medical Sciences is a public medical college against a private one. An MBBS decision should also weigh counselling, bond rules and clinical exposure, not only a package cell.

sections.heading: BMCRI vs Vydehi Institute of Medical Sciences for MBBS: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose BMCRI if you want a public medical college in Bangalore and will confirm the official government MBBS fee, because our recorded ₹7,500 year total sits below this page's ₹10,000 fee floor.

Choose Vydehi if you want a private MBBS at the recorded year total of ₹10.82 lakh, with a 2023 record of ₹5 lakh average and ₹10 lakh highest, after you confirm the official fee and counselling quota.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For BMCRI we hold ₹7,500 as a Total Fees year figure for MBBS. That amount is below this page's ₹10,000 professional fee floor, so we do not treat it as a comparable programme fee in the summary.
Government medical fees can be modest, but you must confirm the official Karnataka counselling circular before you budget.

For Vydehi we hold ₹10.82 lakh as a Total Fees year figure for MBBS. That is a year amount, not a confirmed official 4.5-year total, and we have not multiplied it. Use the official notice and your counselling allotment letter.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Our table records 2023 figures of ₹3 lakh average and ₹6 lakh highest for BMCRI, and ₹5 lakh average and ₹10 lakh highest for Vydehi. These are historical records, not a promise of a campus job.
MBBS graduates typically complete a compulsory internship and then enter postgraduate counselling or clinical work. Ask the colleges what the 2023 rows actually measure.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: Both colleges are listed with NEET. Follow the official Medical Counselling Committee or Karnataka state counselling process for 2026.
BMCRI has India Today ranks of 13 in 2024 and 2023 on our records. Vydehi has no rank row here. These are not NIRF ranks.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Bangalore, Karnataka, so a local student can visit the hospitals on the same trip.
BMCRI is a public medical college and research institute. Vydehi is a private medical institute. Clinical load, teaching hospital and fee quota will not feel the same.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick BMCRI if a public MBBS seat through NEET counselling is the goal, and you have the official government fee circular rather than our below-floor ₹7,500 row.
Pick Vydehi if a private MBBS at the recorded ₹10.82 lakh year total fits your counselling options and budget, after official confirmation.
Let NEET counselling, quota and the official fee decide this, not only the 2023 package cells.
